messages:
deploybot: created release tag `v3.4.1-rc3` from `main` @ commit `ab12c3d4` and kicked off canary in us-west-2. 

Changelog (high level):
- perf: reduce KV-cache memory churn during long sequences
- fix: TLS fallback path for private deployments
- feat: expose batching tunables via REDWOOD_BATCH_* env vars

Canary plan: 10% traffic, 30m observation window, auto-fallback to `v3.4.0` on error threshold (5% error or 50% slowdown p95). Artifacts: s3://redwood-releases/v3.4.1-rc3

ci-bot: smoke tests passed (unit+integration). E2E scheduled in 5m.

sara.k: :eyes: starting dashboards and tracing. tagging this for enterprise pin discussion.

mike.t: quick ask — recommend we advise Dedicated customers to remain pinned at `v3.4.0` until canary clears. I'll ping accounts impacted.

jules: seeing a small p95 uptick on route /generate in canary group at ~12m (+8%). not sure if noise. logs show a few kv-cache GC spikes.

laura: can you paste the sample log line?

jules: ``
2026-03-20T16:12:03Z service=runtime instance=i-0ab123 msg="kv-cache-flush" duration_ms=1223
2026-03-20T16:12:05Z service=runtime instance=i-0ab123 msg="alloc-high" mem_mb=18432
``

ops-oncall: putting canary on hold — pause rollout. tagging incident if we need rollback.

deploybot: Canary paused at 12% traffic. Hold marker applied to tag `v3.4.1-rc3`. Automatic rollback threshold unchanged.

sara.k: adding note to release notes: "canary paused due to elevated p95 on a subset of requests; investigation ongoing."

mike.t: I opened a patch to revert the KV change (PR #1528) as a quick mitigation option. if rollback needed, prefer explicit rollback to v3.4.0 rather than patch-forward.

laura: ops, please confirm if we should pin Dedicated customers now.

ops-oncall: yes — recommend notifying sales + support to pin critical Dedicated tenants to `v3.4.0`. I'll run the pin script and post output here.

ops-oncall: running: `./scripts/pin-tenant --tag v3.4.0 --tenants-file critical-tenants.csv`

ops-oncall: pin script finished: 12 tenants pinned, queued for commit. linked to internal runbook: https://intranet/redwood/runbooks/release-pinning

jules: debug note — the spike correlates with long-tail requests (>1024 tokens) hitting a newly-introduced flush path. investigating a conservative guard in the runtime.

deploybot: artifacts and tag metadata:
- tag: `v3.4.1-rc3`
- commit: `ab12c3d4`
- build: `build-20260320-0847`
- s3: s3://redwood-releases/v3.4.1-rc3
- changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1532

deploybot: if ops rolls back, use: `rdeploy rollback --env canary --to-tag v3.4.0 --reason "p95-regression"`

laura: thanks. I'll update the customer-facing release notes with the pause and the mitigation path.

mike.t: will notify enterprise CS to hold planned upgrades.

sara.k: follow-ups: monitor dashboards for 60m after fixes. keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:

deploybot: thread closed by deploybot — canary paused, tag created, pins applied. Re-open thread if we proceed or rollback.
